name: external-cli
description: Scaffold a resource centered on an installed executable, version detection, and platform-aware install guidance.

RESOURCE_PORTABILITY_TIER.description: Portability tier for the generated scaffold.

RESOURCE_BINARY.description: Executable name to probe on PATH.

RESOURCE_CLI_COMMAND.description: Installed command name for the generated resource CLI.

platformExpectations: Generated scaffolds should treat installation, binary detection, and health probing as first-class concerns.
Version detection should stay separate from auth/config validation.
